relationships.subject: Diclofenac sodium
relationships.evidence_quote: Diclofenac sodium used as an intracanal medication significantly reduced postoperative pain compared with Ca(OH)2.

relationships.subject: Calcium hydroxide
relationships.evidence_quote: Ca(OH)2 demonstrated a greater reduction in MMP-9 levels

key_findings: Intracanal diclofenac reduced postoperative pain more than Ca(OH)2.
Both agents lowered periapical MMP-9, more so with Ca(OH)2.
